metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in southern Iran increase on January 13, 2020, compared to January 8, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1/2 for water detection - Two specific dates: Jan 8, 2020 and Jan 13, 2020 - Location: Southern Iran (need to define a representative region) - Best approach: Use Sentinel-1 SAR (cloud-independent) or Sentinel-2 water indices 2. Masking strategy: - For water detection, I'll use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) with Sentinel-2 - Mask clouds using QA60 band - Apply threshold (NDWI > 0 typically indicates water) - Or use JRC water occurrence if more reliable 3. Logic for answer: - Valid Zero (A/B): If we successfully calculate water extent for both dates and compare - C1: If no images found for one or both dates - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - Compare water pixel counts between the two dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define southern Iran region (approximate area) const southernIran = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[50.0, 27.0], [60.0, 27.0], [60.0, 30.0], [50.0, 30.0], [50.0, 27.0]] ]); // Date definitions const date1 = '2020-01-08'; const date2 = '2020-01-13'; // Function to get water extent for a specific date function getWaterExtent(date) { const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); // Try Sentinel-2 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(southernIran) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${date} - Sentinel-2 images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { return null; } // Use mosaic to combine images if multiple const image = collection.mosaic(); // Cloud masking using QA60 const cloudMask = image.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) .and(image.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)); const masked = image.updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate NDWI (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) const ndwi = masked.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Threshold for water (NDWI > 0) const water = ndwi.gt(0); // Count water pixels const stats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: southernIran, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels = stats.get('NDWI').getInfo(); // Also count total valid pixels const validStats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southernIran, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const totalPixels = validStats.get('NDWI').getInfo(); return { waterPixels: waterPixels, totalPixels: totalPixels }; } // Get water extent for both dates const result1 = getWaterExtent(date1); const result2 = getWaterExtent(date2); // Check for missing data if (result1 === null || result2 === null) { console.log("Missing data for one or both dates."); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log(`Jan 8, 2020 - Water pixels: ${result1.waterPixels}, Total valid: ${result1.totalPixels}`); console.log(`Jan 13, 2020 - Water pixels: ${result2.waterPixels}, Total valid: ${result2.totalPixels}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (result1.totalPixels === 0 || result2.totalPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for invalid results if (result1.waterPixels === null || result2.waterPixels === null || isNaN(result1.waterPixels) || isNaN(result2.waterPixels)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare water extent if (result2.waterPixels > result1.waterPixels) { console.log("Water extent increased on Jan 13 compared to Jan 8."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Water extent did not increase on Jan 13 compared to Jan 8."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
